_note: claim 정본 — docs/EVIDENCE-MAP.md(수동 v0)의 기계가독 후계. evidence_steps 는 reports/REPRODUCE-RESULT.json 의 스텝 키. boundary 는 정직 경계(증거가 증명하지 않는 것) 필수.

claims.title: Registry root reproduces byte-identically (95 modules / 502 apps)
claims.boundary: Byte-identical reproduction is determinism, not correctness (INV-R1) — correctness comes from the independent-check claims below.

claims.title: Every template app re-seals byte-identically with rediscovery cross-check
claims.boundary: Covers template apps managed by forge; frontier/factory apps are covered by claim.frontier.reproducible.

claims.title: Frontier/factory Shor apps re-seal (or coherence-verify) deterministically
claims.boundary: changed-only mode uses fingerprint coherence for unchanged specs + factory byte-identity re-seal; full mode re-runs every frontier generator.

claims.title: All sealed modules pass an independently implemented dense oracle (83/83)
claims.boundary: Independent implementation, shared conventions (endian/phase/atol) — the convention gap is audited by claim.oracle.convention_independence.

claims.title: Seal verdicts survive convention variation (global phase, atol)
claims.boundary: Audits the shared-assumption gap between oracles; does not eliminate it.

claims.title: Structural Shor modexp cores compute w·a^c mod N exactly on the computational basis
claims.boundary: Modexp core only — computational-basis permutation by independent integer arithmetic; not the full unitary (that is the column_exact claim, for n≤18).

claims.title: 27 Shor apps (n≤18): full unitary (H·iQFT included) matches the Shor spectral formula on every column
claims.boundary: float-atol grade (same evidence class as Tier-0 dense C4) — NOT ring-exact; the ring_exact_companion (iQFT ℤ[ζ256] float 0) supplies a heterogeneous exact witness.

claims.title: 2 large Shor apps (n≥19: shor1285/3683): compositionally verified — exhaustive modexp permutation + ring-exact iQFT + H-wall, composed
claims.boundary: composition argument (not whole-column dense); stronger than subspace_permutation, weaker than column_exact. Only shor1285/3683; rs73 stays subspace-grade.

claims.title: Sealed Trotter/Suzuki apps carry symbolic-exact upper bounds vs their target e^{-iHt}
claims.boundary: ε is an upper bound (no tightness claim); unitary channels only; the seals themselves stay exact circuit-unitaries.

claims.title: Sealed resource counts equal the independently recomputed child sums
claims.boundary: Resource bookkeeping only — not a statement about circuit semantics.

claims.title: Sealed Shor-15 unitaries produce the textbook period peaks; cmul2_mod21 has orbit period 6
claims.boundary: Behavioral illustration on sealed goldens — execution is not seal evidence; readouts stay illustrative.

claims.title: All observation witnesses (verification paths, topology, contextuality, MTC, knots, …) re-verify
claims.boundary: Observations, not seals — exact math checks recorded as sidecars; they add no sealed circuits and leave the root unchanged.
